reason: I have cooked kra pao and green curry for my kids for years, and most days I buy a 50-baht plate because I have no time, not because I don't know how. I won't pay 99 baht for recipes when I can watch the same dishes free on YouTube.
objection: Only two free dishes, and I already cook both, so I would run out after two dinners and learn nothing. My problem is time and a tiny kitchen corner, not recipes, and more recipes don't fix that.
would_change_my_mind: Let me try one Sunday cook-ahead plan free. If it really feeds my family for less than buying 50-baht plates and works in my small kitchen corner, I would pay the 99 baht.
